final_wiki.Q-6053:
Q-6053: How many days are there from 2020-12-13 to 2021-12-12 (count the end date but not the start date)?

Answer: 364

Reasoning: From 2020-12-13 to 2021-12-13 is exactly 365 days (the leap day of Feb 29, 2020 has already passed, and 2021 is not a leap year). Since 2021-12-12 is one day before 2021-12-13, the count is 365 - 1 = 364 days.
